evidence.title: GitHub - zippystarter/template-devstarter: A one page developer portfolio template
Devstarter - Developer portfolio template built with shadcn & Next.js.

name: Devstarter
summary: Free, open-source one-page developer portfolio template built with Next.js, shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS.
description: A single-page developer portfolio with a cyberpunk look: neon accents, monospace type and light/dark modes. Sections cover hero, projects, skills, blog posts and a contact form, all built on shadcn theming and modern CSS (Grid, Subgrid, view transitions).
contains: one-page portfolio: hero, projects, skills, blog and contact
project cards with images, tech tags and links
shadcn theming with light and dark modes
modern CSS: Grid, Subgrid, backdrop blur, view transitions
Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript 5.8
